description: ppl, the personal CRM for AI agents. Give your agent a durable memory of the people who matter: briefings, notes, reminders, tasks, calls, gifts, and journal entries, all over a hosted MCP server.

ppl.note: Official ppl MCP server (hosted, Streamable HTTP, 85 tools). Authorizes with the user's ppl API token, passed as a Bearer token. On first connect, the agent guides the user through the one-approval connect flow at https://withppl.com/agents to mint a token, so the human never has to copy a token by hand. Lets the agent remember facts, get briefings, log notes and calls, manage reminders, tasks, gifts, and journal entries.

name: ppl
